name: cfg-agent-thinking
about: 已弃用但仍生效的 agent.thinking（loadPilotConfig.ts:474-482 只在 enabled===true 时保留 {enabled, budgetTokens}；SessionAgentConfigBundle.ts:165-171 作为会话 thinking 的最后一级回落；pilotdeck-agent-loop-default-factory.ts:801-818 asThinkingConfig）：enabled=true + budgetTokens=2048 时 anthropic 与 openai 两种协议请求里的推理参数。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: anth/m
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  thinking:
    enabled: true
    budgetTokens: 2048
model:
  providers:
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anth/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            supportsPromptCache: false
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
